blind.description: A standing humanoid figure completely encased in thick, cord-like bands of webbing or mummy wraps. The swaddled head leans slightly forward, with facial features obscured by horizontal bindings. The body forms a solid, tapered column wrapped in spiraling, fleshy strands of web that pool outward at the base into rounded dough-like mounds. Near the lower front-left of the base, a small dark cavity or opening is visible.
blind.from_above: An oval wrapped knob (the head) centered above a spreading circular mass of lumpy, doughy folds, resembling a coiled turban or rolled pastry with a dark recess near one edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5 feet tall (reaching roughly the chest or shoulders of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 to 2.5 feet wide at the pooled base.

notes: base web pooling makes footprint wider than catalog proportion but matches requested clump of web
